title: Full test suite fails on a clean machine: TC-E2E-004 raises FileNotFoundError (axe-core not shipped)
root_cause: The accessibility test loaded axe-core from tools/node/node_modules, which is excluded from the submission zip; the README had no step that installs it.
fix: axe-core 4.14.0 vendored into tests/e2e/vendor (with its MPL-2.0 licence); the test no longer depends on node_modules.
steps: Extract zip → pip install → playwright install chromium → pytest

title: README command 'pytest -m smoke | -m security | …' is not runnable (shell pipe; exit 127)
root_cause: Alternatives were written on one line separated by '|', which the shell reads as a pipe.
fix: One runnable command per marker in the README.
steps: Copy the README line into a terminal

title: A marker run (pytest -m smoke) overwrites reports/results.json; regenerated report shrinks from 80 to 52 pages
root_cause: conftest wrote results.json at the end of every session, including partial ones, so the evidence file held only 16 cases.
fix: Only a full run (no -m/-k, default test paths) writes results.json; partial runs write results_partial.json.
steps: pytest -m smoke, then regenerate the report

title: A fresh mutation run breaks make_charts, make_workbook and deck.js (missing iterations / equivalent / score)
root_cause: Equivalent-mutant classification and the iteration history had been added to mutation.json by hand after the run; mutation.py itself never wrote them.
fix: mutation.py now classifies the three proven-equivalent mutants itself, computes the mutation score and rebuilds the iteration history from mutation_iter*.json.
steps: python tools/mutation.py, then the regeneration commands

title: Document generators depend on lab-only paths (/mnt/skills, /tmp) and undeclared Node packages
root_cause: Generators were written inside the lab sandbox and reused its helper scripts and global Node packages.
fix: Own theme helper (tools/deck/theme.js); LibreOffice fallback in toc_pass.py; video asset moved into docs/figures/video; package.json declares docx, pptxgenjs, react, react-dom, react-icons, sharp; README gains 'npm install'.
steps: Run the regeneration commands on a machine without the lab sandbox
